createIndex.title: An index being created. ``result`` is the index as the service answered; ``wait_until_ready`` waits until it can be used.
createIndex.summary: Read the index until it is ready, and return it.

deleteIndex.title: An index being deleted. ``wait_until_deleted`` waits until it is gone and its name can be used again.
deleteIndex.summary: Read the index until it no longer exists.
